source_state: Uncommitted My Journey zoom/pan follow-up; not deployed or published.
method: Actual JourneyPanel and JourneyMap React components with existing EQM styles, rendered in an isolated loopback Vite preview. Headless Edge/Playwright interactions; screenshots crop the complete map toolbar, viewport and legend.
data: Synthetic Demo Cartographer account, eight visits and six systems. System names, observations and X/Z layout are illustrative synthetic fixtures; these are not actual SDE positions, live flight logs, or a verified gate route. Local mock HTTP endpoints only; no live OAuth, ESI, user data or game actions.

checks: Wheel zoom anchors the cursor and prevents page scrolling
Background dragging pans accurately and stops after release
Dragging from a star pans without selecting; the next click selects normally
Focus selected centers the system, markers retain size, and keyboard controls work
Timeline scrubbing and returning to latest preserve the chosen viewport
Pointer capture supports dragging outside the map and clears on release
Mobile pinch zoom and one-finger pan work without document overflow
Cancelled touch gestures clear capture state and allow the next drag

limitations: Browser checks use the real frontend with synthetic HTTP responses, not a production deployment or backend integration test. Existing read-only journey API and replay data contract are unchanged.
